title: Empty Box Claim with Critical Weight Delta

carrier_telemetry.carrier_exception_notes: Delivered to porch with proof photo

ticket.subject: The box was EMPTY! Scam!
ticket.message: I opened the box and there were only packing peanuts inside, no headphones! Refund my $420 immediately or I will contact my bank to initiate a chargeback.

ground_truth_verdict.policy_reasoning: UPS destination scale weight at local delivery hub was 3.78 lbs, matching origin weight of 3.80 lbs. Package could not have been delivered empty. High historical return rate (66.7%). Deny instant refund and escalate to fraud investigation.
